newsitem.title: FRANCE: Anyone better than National Front - French Jews.
newsitem.headline: Anyone better than National Front - French Jews.

text.p: France's Jewish community urged French people on Wednesday to vote in parliamentary elections on May 25 and June 1 in order to stand in the way of Jean-Marie Le Pen's far-right National Front.
"Abstaining or casting a blank vote would reinforce the extreme-right," the CRIF, France's umbrella group for secular Jewish organisations, said in a statement.
"Like us, you do not want France to be contaminated by the National Front's ideology, or for republican values to be endangered," it said. It recommended voting for any "democratic candidate".
Mainstream politicians are worried that voters' scepticism and disenchantment could boost abstention or the National Front.
Le Pen, who insists he is not anti-Semitic, has caused outrage by espousing racial inequality and saying the Nazi gas chambers were "a detail of history".
He advocates sending home France's four million mostly North African immigrants and reserving jobs, welfare and housing for French citizens,
Although he is not running, polls have predicted his party could win up to three seats in the National Assembly.
